title: S06T04 - Add VS Code MCP and generic AGENTS.md/MCP adapters with context budgets
description: Support standards-based clients through portable MCP and instruction manifests while bounding tool exposure and prompt/context overhead.
acceptanceCriteria: A generic client can install Boreal instructions and project-scoped MCP config without target-specific code.
Adapters declare tool subsets and measured context cost so users can select core, standard, or full capability profiles.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
